policy.principle: A repair is incomplete until the incident is converted into a permanent system invariant, implemented in the canonical path, regression-tested, enforced by CI, governed through release admission, and recorded in durable repair and advancement ledgers.

repairs.incident: Hybrid/bootstrap and legacy Windows entrypoints could diverge or create parallel runtime/agent ownership; production bootstrap routing and source contracts could also drift from the implementation that physical-PC proof exercised.
repairs.invariant: For one approved root, OMEGA has one canonical localhost runtime on 127.0.0.1:8127, one sovereign outbound agent, one authenticated Hybrid session and one bounded local execution-authority lease. RCWA, SAI, tests, builds and validation dispatch through that existing agent. Capability actions never launch another OMEGA runtime. Legacy launch/install entrypoints delegate to the stable sovereign gateway or fail closed.
repairs.authority_boundary: The stable gateway and bounded development executor grant no Canon, GitHub, deployment or promotion authority. Physical PC online/execution claims remain heartbeat- and receipt-gated. Release promotion remains controlled by the exact-head release-forward controller.
repairs.release_admission: CANDIDATE until exact-head source/Windows/RCWA/Hybrid/verified-return gates pass, the current canonical base is reconciled, the governed merge completes, release-forward deploys the exact canonical SHA, live cumulative acceptance passes without writer replacement/rollback, and the physical-PC single-session path is verified.
